# C7 — Deployment reliability evidence

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | **SUPPORTED WITHIN STATED LIMITS** — Evidence supports the statement as worded, at its evidence class only. |
| Strongest accepted evidence | MODEL ONLY |
| Evidence classes cited | IMPLEMENTATION, TEST PROCEDURE, ANALYTICAL, SIMULATED |
| Gate reached | SOFTWARE REPRODUCTION (next: SYNTHETIC TEST) |
| Last review | CURRENT — human recorded 2026-11-14 by chief weapons engineer |

**Question.** Does simulated deployment succeed in at least 99.9% of trials under manufacturing tolerances, and is that simulation informative?

**Current statement.** Revision 2 of the Monte Carlo integrates the fin's equation of motion through the verified four-bar kinematics at the shared design point, sampling spring rate and preload, fin mass and inertia, egress speed, friction, aero coefficient, trigger latency, stop-angle scatter, and link tolerances (through a numerically derived toggle gradient). Every counted failure mode can occur. In 10,000 seeded trials, 9,993 succeed (99.93 percent, above both the 99 percent sponsor gate and the 99.9 percent requirement); all 7 failures are the stop-angle manufacturing-tolerance tail. No physical deployment has been observed.

## Discrepancies

- [D-010](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-010) (RESOLVED) No shared design point across the mass, spring, reliability, and structural models
- [D-013](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-013) (RESOLVED) The reliability simulation cannot produce the failures it counts
- [D-014](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-014) (RESOLVED) The historical 10,000-trial summary could not be reconstructed from its CSV

## Assumptions

- A reliability statement needs a trial count, seed, model revision, and outcome definition.
- Link tolerances map to toggle-position shifts linearly (verified by a numerical gradient about the nominal).

## Limitations

- Simulation outcomes do not measure physical reliability.
- No empirical confidence bound is asserted.
- The dominant modeled failure source is stop-angle tolerance; as-built tolerance data does not exist.

## Measurement needed to close the next gate

- Repeated inert deployment trials of a physical mechanism at the militarized dimensions (compare to PRED-C7-LOCK-FRACTION).

## Pre-registered experiments

- None.

## What this claim does not establish

- Any inert physical measurement: none has been accepted for this claim.
- Physical performance of any hardware.
- Flight readiness or safety for live propulsion.
